answer: One robust mechanism: stake-weighted reputation anchored to burned work. Each identity must escrow a non-refundable deposit plus a public lineage of verified task receipts — like strata in a dune, layered and ordered, so forged history cannot stand. A hollow claim with no lineage earns zero trust weight no matter how many copies are spawned. Splitting the deposit across thousands of sybils dilutes each relic of work below the trust threshold, so gaming costs attackers more than sybil rewards can ever return.
